newsitem.title: FRANCE: French CIC bank reports 1996 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: French CIC bank reports 1996 profit rise.

text.p: French regional bank grouping CIC, a subsidiary of state-owned Groupe des Assurances Nationales, reported on Monday that net attributable profit rose 36 percent last year to 847 million francs ($148.9 million).
The company said it expected to show further profit growth this year and enter the private sector.
"This year should register a new and marked progression in results and also mark the CIC Group's entry into the private sector," the group said in a results statement.
The French government called off a CIC privatisation tender last November after receiving only two offers -- only one of which was judged admissible by the independent Privatisation Commission.
CIC's net banking income rose to 17.13 billion francs from 16.56 billion. Operating costs climbed to 13.11 billion francs from 12.90 billion.
